title: Photosynthesis in two stages
caption: The light-dependent reactions in the thylakoid membranes split water, release oxygen and make ATP and NADPH. The Calvin cycle in the stroma uses them to fix CO₂ into sugars. Overall: 6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂.
alt: Five boxes in order: light and water, the light-dependent reactions, ATP and NADPH, the Calvin cycle, and glucose and other products.
description: Light and water: light energy; H₂O from the roots.
Light-dependent reactions: thylakoid membranes: water split, O₂ released, ATP and NADPH made.
ATP and NADPH: carry energy and hydrogen to the stroma.
Calvin cycle: stroma: CO₂ fixed and reduced to triose phosphate.
Glucose and other products: sugars, starch, cellulose, amino acids, lipids.
